links.comparator_used: Single models (logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost) trained with class weighting, compared with the stacking ensemble and the L1-optimized LR model
links.outcome: Discrimination (AUC) for predicting postoperative recurrence in pediatric CRS
links.effect: L1-optimized LR AUC 0.689, comparable to the other four class-weighted models (including the stacking ensemble); no ensemble advantage reported
links.quote: The L1-optimized LR model retained three predictors-nasal polyps, a higher Lund-Mackay CT score, and diffuse extent-each associated with higher recurrence risk, and achieved an AUC of 0.689, comparable to that of the other four class-weighted models.
